purpose: Register the replacement scorer-complete repeated smoke without modifying the historical v5 run or claiming equality between naturally different evidence representations.

parent_preregistration.inheritance: All v5 provenance, blinding, whole-record, provider and reporting provisions remain binding unless this document expressly strengthens them. Historical v5 artifacts remain immutable evidence and are never reused as v6 outputs.

release_binding.policy: The preregistration is release/profile agnostic. Before inference, a separate signed readiness manifest must bind exactly one immutable synthetic bundle, deployed profile, graph, source manifest and source-role inventory by absolute path, byte count and SHA-256.

smoke_contract.provider_seed_limitation: The derived seed is recorded in the schedule; if the provider does not accept a seed, repeated calls are reported as unseeded provider repeats and are not represented as deterministic samples.

primary_estimand.failure_outcome_policy: Registered provider, transport, parse and schema failures remain in the intention-to-evaluate denominator as zero; scorer material itself must nevertheless be semantically evaluable before any call.
primary_estimand.decision_rule: A positive KG claim requires an evaluated paired interval for all 60 registered E4/E1 pairs and a strictly positive preregistered lower confidence bound. Otherwise report null, negative, or not evaluable exactly as observed.

semantic_preflight.scope: Every sealed expectation and every scenario-by-arm scorer evidence cell

budget_ladder.balance_rule: The maximum minus minimum number of assigned scenario clusters across registered ceiling levels is at most one.
budget_ladder.primary_interpretation: E4 versus E1 estimates representation performance under a randomized capacity regime with a ceiling matched within each scenario cluster. It does not isolate semantics at exactly equal achieved token, byte, character or item lengths.
secondary_reporting: paired E4-E1 effect at each ceiling
pooled paired E4-E1 effect across the registered ceiling distribution
actual tokens, items, UTF-8 bytes and text characters for every call

randomisation.budget_assignment: seeded balanced shuffle of sorted scenario-cluster IDs, performed without reading material values
randomisation.question_and_arm_blinding: Provider requests contain neither arm identity nor gold/scorer fields

required_outputs: provider request identifiers proving three non-cached repeats
repeatability by arm and scenario cluster
semantic preflight and signed inventory commitments
forbidden_claims: independent observations when repeats share a scenario cluster
causal KG benefit when the primary is incomplete or not evaluable

adjacent_cleanroom_work.not_part_of_this_estimand: Commercial-proof citation acceptance and model-training arms are adjacent clean-room programmes, not evidence for the KG E4-versus-E1 causal contrast.

execution_authorisation.required_external_gate: A release-specific Ed25519 v6 binding must rehash this preregistration, the new scenario/material/preflight artifacts, deployed release/profile, tokenizer and every required source role before inference is reachable.

self_digest_algorithm: sha256(canonical-json(document-without-self_sha256); UTF-8; keys sorted; separators comma+colon; ensure_ascii=false)
